title: Prepositions of Time & Place: In, On, At & Zero Prepositions
subtitle: CEFR A1–A2 • Spatial Containers, Surface Contact & Precision Point Anchors

topics.title: 1. IN (Containers & Long Periods)
topics.subtitle: Enclosed Spaces, Cities, Months & Years
topics.explanation: Digunakan ketika objek berada di dalam batas wilayah tertutup (ruangan, kota, negara) atau rentang waktu yang luas (bulan, tahun, musim, dekade).
topics.rationale: Bayangkan 'IN' sebagai kotak tiga dimensi atau kalender besar yang membungkus suatu kejadian dari segala sisi.

formulas.pattern: S + V + in + [City / Country / Room / Month / Year]
S + Aux + not + V + in + [Enclosed Space / Period]

conditionalExamples.positive: Our engineering team works in Jakarta and launches in October.
conditionalExamples.negative: We don't hold physical meetings in the main lobby.
conditionalExamples.question: Did you finish your degree in 2025?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Kota (Jakarta), bulan (October), dan tahun (2025) semuanya dianggap wadah luas.

xrayTokens.nuance: Nama bulan tanpa tanggal spesifik selalu memakai 'in'

specialExceptions.title: Parts of the Day (In the morning/afternoon/evening)
specialExceptions.explanation: Bagian hari yang panjang memakai 'in the...', tetapi malam hari memakai 'at night'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: I usually study coding in night.
specialExceptions.correctExample: I usually study coding in the evening or at night.

tipsAndTricks: Setiap kali menyebut nama bulan saja atau tahun saja, otak otomatis memilih 'IN'.

topics.title: 2. ON (Surfaces, Streets & Days)
topics.subtitle: Physical Contact, Specific Days & Calendar Dates
topics.explanation: Digunakan untuk benda yang menempel di atas permukaan datar, nama jalan (tanpa nomor bangunan), serta hari dan tanggal spesifik.
topics.rationale: Secara visual, 'ON' berarti menyentuh permukaan luar atau menempel pada satu kotak tanggal spesifik di kalender.

formulas.pattern: S + V + on + [Surface / Street / Day / Specific Date]
S + Aux + not + V + on + [Day / Date / Surface]
Aux + S + V + on + [Day / Date / Surface]?

conditionalExamples.positive: The design review is on Friday, and the report is on your desk.
conditionalExamples.negative: Our office isn't open on Sunday mornings.
conditionalExamples.question: Are you flying to Bandung on November 15th?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Begitu tanggal muncul (November 15th), preposisi berubah dari 'in' menjadi 'on'.

specialExceptions.title: Public Transport Rule (On a bus / train / plane)
specialExceptions.explanation: Kendaraan besar tempat kita bisa berdiri dan berjalan di lorongnya memakai 'on', bukan 'in'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: I am reading a book in the train.
specialExceptions.correctExample: I am reading a book on the train (tapi: in a car / in a taxi).

tipsAndTricks: Jika kata waktunya mengandung kata 'Day' (Monday, Birthday, Holiday) atau tanggal pasti, gunakan 'ON'.

topics.title: 3. AT (Exact Points & Clock Time)
topics.subtitle: Specific Coordinates, Addresses & Exact Hours
topics.explanation: Digunakan untuk titik lokasi paling presisi (alamat lengkap bernomor, titik temu) dan waktu jam yang tepat.
topics.rationale: Bayangkan 'AT' sebagai pin merah di Google Maps atau jarum jam yang menunjuk satu angka pasti.

formulas.pattern: S + V + at + [Exact Time / Specific Point / Full Address]
S + Aux + not + V + at + [Exact Time / Location Point]
What time / Where + Aux + S + V + at?

conditionalExamples.positive: Let's meet at the station entrance at 7:30 PM.
conditionalExamples.negative: He doesn't arrive at the office until 9:00 AM.
conditionalExamples.question: Will you be at the airport gate at noon?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Titik temu spesifik (station entrance, airport gate) memakai 'at' agar tidak tersesat.

specialExceptions.title: At the weekend vs. On the weekend
specialExceptions.explanation: Keduanya benar: penutur British cenderung memakai 'at the weekend', sedangkan American memakai 'on the weekend'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: What do you do in the weekend?
specialExceptions.correctExample: What do you do on the weekend? / at the weekend?

tipsAndTricks: Ingat piramida terbalik: IN (Kota/Bulan) → ON (Jalan/Hari) → AT (Alamat Nomor/Jam).

topics.title: 4. Zero Preposition Zones (When to Omit In, On, At)
topics.subtitle: Deictic Time Markers (Next, Last, This, Every) & Directional 'Home'
topics.explanation: Jangan gunakan 'in', 'on', atau 'at' sebelum kata penunjuk waktu relatif seperti this, next, last, every, yesterday, tomorrow, maupun sebelum kata 'home' dengan kata kerja gerak (go/come/arrive).
topics.rationale: Kata-kata seperti 'next Friday' atau 'yesterday' sudah membawa informasi penunjuk waktu di dalam dirinya sendiri, sehingga preposisi menjadi mubazir.

formulas.pattern: S + V + [this / next / last / every + Time]  |  S + go/arrive + home
S + Aux + not + V + [yesterday / tomorrow / next week]
Aux + S + V + [this weekend / next month]?

conditionalExamples.positive: We are deploying the new release next Tuesday.
conditionalExamples.negative: I didn't join the standup call yesterday morning.
conditionalExamples.question: Are you working from home this Friday?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Bandingkan: 'on Friday' (memakai on), tetapi 'next Friday' dan 'this Friday' (tanpa on).

conditionalExamples.conditionTitle: GOING HOME VS. STAYING AT HOME
conditionalExamples.positive: I usually go home at 6 PM and relax at home.
conditionalExamples.negative: She didn't get home until midnight.
conditionalExamples.question: What time are you heading home tonight?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Kata kerja gerak (go/get/head) + home = tanpa 'to/at'. Kata kerja diam (stay/be/relax) = at home.

specialExceptions.title: Kesalahan Paling Umum: 'Go to home' & 'On next week'
specialExceptions.explanation: Hindari menyisipkan 'to' sebelum 'home' dan hindari 'on/in' sebelum 'next/last'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: I will go to home and call you on next Monday.
specialExceptions.correctExample: I will go home and call you next Monday.

tipsAndTricks: Begitu mulut mengucapkan kata 'this, next, last, every', langsung kunci preposisi—jangan ucapkan 'in/on/at'!

scenario.interlocutor: Tech Lead menanyakan jadwal rilis fitur baru
scenario.intent: Menjawab jadwal hari tertentu menggunakan penanda waktu relatif.

practiceQuiz.question: Pilih kalimat yang paling tepat dan natural untuk dikirim di Slack:

options.text: We will deploy the update on next Monday at 9 AM.
We will deploy the update next Monday at 9 AM.
We will deploy the update next Monday in 9 AM.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: 'Next Monday' tidak memakai preposisi karena diawali 'next', sedangkan jam spesifik '9 AM' wajib memakai 'at'.
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A keliru menambahkan 'on' sebelum 'next Monday', dan Opsi C salah memakai 'in' untuk jam.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Aturan cepat: 'on Monday' (pakai on), 'next Monday' (tanpa on).
